title: registry-facts/1
description: Per-product selection-rule facts with provenance and expiry: registry/facts/<plugin_id>.json (DESIGN.md 11 'per-product capability facts with provenance and expiry'). Separate from verdicts: facts are what a selection rule may consume (adopted/maintainer info, last-verified date, capability facts); verdicts are conformance outcomes.
$comment: DESIGN.md 11. Facts are data, never executable, and expire with the same key components verdicts do (expires_with names which ones). The $id host is a placeholder (DESIGN.md 'Open questions').

last_verified.$comment: Date of the last check that verified a recorded claim (never a claim that no check verified).

source.$comment: Provenance: where the fact was measured or read (a manifest claim, a check run, a live run).

expires_with.$comment: Which verdict-key components this fact's validity expires with (DESIGN.md 11: facts carry expiry).
